episodes.title: Offred
episodes.summary: Offred, one the few fertile women known as Handmaids in the oppressive Republic of Gilead, struggles to survive as a reproductive surrogate for a powerful Commander and his resentful wife.

episodes.title: Birth Day
episodes.summary: Offred and her fellow Handmaids assist with the delivery of Janine's baby, prompting Offred to recall her own daughter's birth. Offred draws closer to Ofglen while dreading a secret meeting with the Commander.

episodes.title: Late
episodes.summary: Offred visits Janine's baby with Serena Joy and remembers the early days of the revolution before Gilead. Ofglen faces a difficult challenge.

episodes.title: Nolite Te Bastardes Carborundorum
episodes.summary: Punished by Serena Joy, Offred begins to unravel and reflects on her time with Moira at the Red Center. A complication during the Ceremony threatens Offred's survival with the Commander and Serena...

episodes.title: Faithful
episodes.summary: Serena Joy makes Offred a surprising proposition. Offred remembers the unconventional beginnings of her relationship with her husband.

episodes.title: A Woman's Place
episodes.summary: A Mexican Ambassador visiting Gilead questions Offred about her life as a Handmaid. Serena Joy reflects on her marriage and the role she once played in Gilead's inception.

episodes.title: The Other Side
episodes.summary: Remembering her family's treacherous escape attempt, a shocking revelation from life before Gilead provides a new perspective on Offred's life.

episodes.title: Jezebels
episodes.summary: The Commander surprises Offred with a secret adventure in Gilead. Nick's troubled past leads to his recruitment by the Sons of Jacob.

episodes.title: The Bridge
episodes.summary: Offred embarks on a dangerous mission for the resistance. Janine moves to a new posting. Serena Joy suspects the Commander's infidelity.

episodes.title: Night
episodes.summary: Serena Joy confronts Offred and the Commander. Offred struggles with a complicated, life-changing revelation. The Handmaids face a brutal decision.

episodes.title: June
episodes.summary: Offred reckons with the consequences of a dangerous decision while haunted by memories from her past and the violent beginnings of Gilead.

episodes.title: Unwomen
episodes.summary: Offred adjusts to a new way of life. The arrival of an unexpected person disrupts the Colonies. A family is torn apart by the rise of Gilead.

episodes.title: Baggage
episodes.summary: Offred reflects on her relationship with her mother as she navigates her way through Gilead. In Little America, Moira tries to cope with the trauma she endured.

episodes.title: Other Women
episodes.summary: A baby shower provokes a troubling shift in Offred's relationship with Serena Joy. Offred reckons with the choice she made that led her to become a Handmaid.

episodes.title: Seeds
episodes.summary: Offred spirals as a Gilead ceremony disrupts her relationship with Nick; Janine tries to adjust to life in the Colonies, jeopardizing her friendship with Emily.

episodes.title: First Blood
episodes.summary: Offred finds unexpected allies and obstacles in her search for a way to protect Hannah; The Commander prepares for the dedication of a new Red Center; Nick struggles with his new assignment.

episodes.title: After
episodes.summary: An incident sends shockwaves through both Gilead and Little America. Serena Joy makes a dangerous choice in order to protect her family. Moira searches for someone from her past.

episodes.title: Women's Work
episodes.summary: A sick baby tests Offred and Serena. Janine finally faces Naomi.

episodes.title: Smart Power
episodes.summary: The Waterfords embark on a diplomatic trip abroad. Serena faces the temptation of life outside Gilead. Luke and Moira grapple with survivor's guilt. Offred seeks support from allies.

episodes.title: The Last Ceremony
episodes.summary: A frustrated Serena becomes desperate. The Commander tries to make amends with Offred. Nick pushes Eden farther away. Offred is faced with an unexpected reunion.

episodes.title: Holly
episodes.summary: Offred faces a grueling challenge as she recalls her life as a mother. Serena Joy and the Commander deal with the fallout of their actions towards Offred.

episodes.title: Postpartum
episodes.summary: Offred is sent to a familiar place. Emily is assigned to a mysterious new house.

episodes.title: The Word
episodes.summary: Serena and the other Wives strive to make change. Emily learns more about her new Commander. Offred faces a difficult decision.

episodes.title: Night
episodes.summary: June embarks on a bold mission with unexpected consequences. Emily and Nichole make a harrowing journey. The Waterfords reckon with Serena Joy's choice to send Nichole away.

episodes.title: Mary and Martha
episodes.summary: June helps Marthas with a dangerous task while navigating a relationship with her pious and untrustworthy new walking partner.

episodes.title: Useful
episodes.summary: June navigates a challenging meeting. Serena Joy attempts to recuperate. Lawrence teaches June a hard lesson about the difficult decisions he makes as a Commander.

episodes.title: God Bless the Child
episodes.summary: June negotiates a truce in the Waterfords' fractured relationship.

episodes.title: Unknown Caller
episodes.summary: June and Serena grapple with a new revelation about Nichole, leading to an incident that will have far-reaching ramifications.

episodes.title: Household
episodes.summary: June makes an important connection as she attempts to protect Nichole while accompanying the Waterfords to Washington D.C., where a powerful family offers a glimpse of the future of Gilead.

episodes.title: Under His Eye
episodes.summary: June escalates her risky efforts to find Hannah. Emily must face her past crimes as the ongoing international diplomatic crisis becomes more complicated. Serena and Fred contemplate their future.

episodes.title: Unfit
episodes.summary: June and the rest of the Handmaids shun Ofmatthew, and both are pushed to their limit at the hands of Aunt Lydia, who reflects on her life and relationships before the rise of Gilead.

episodes.title: Heroic
episodes.summary: Confined in a hospital, June's sanity begins to fray. An encounter with Serena Joy forces June to reassess her recent actions.

episodes.title: Witness
episodes.summary: June must deal with a devious ploy on the part of Commander Waterford.

episodes.title: Liars
episodes.summary: A return to Jezebels puts everything in jeopardy. Serena Joy and Commander Waterford take a clandestine trip.

episodes.title: Sacrifice
episodes.summary: A major change rocks the entire Lawrence household. Luke and Moira adjust to new arrivals in Canada.

episodes.title: Mayday
episodes.summary: June must decide how far she's willing to go. Serena Joy and Commander Waterford think about a new way forward.

episodes.title: Pigs
episodes.summary: On the run, June and the fugitive Handmaids seek refuge. In Gilead, Aunt Lydia reels from the loss of 86 children on Angels' Flight. The combative Waterfords, in custody in Toronto, learn of June's feat.

episodes.title: Nightshade
episodes.summary: June continues to plot revenge. In Toronto, Moira deals with the fallout of June's choices.

episodes.title: The Crossing
episodes.summary: Aunt Lydia seeks vengeance. Nick and Lawrence collaborate to protect June. In Toronto, Luke struggles with how to help.

episodes.title: Milk
episodes.summary: June takes a harrowing journey. Janine remembers a stressful experience in her past. In Toronto, Serena tries to manipulate Rita.

episodes.title: Chicago
episodes.summary: June seeks out more active rebels, while Janine tries to help her fit in with their new group of survivors.

episodes.title: Vows
episodes.summary: June contemplates the possibility of freedom.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.summary: June contends with joy, pain and rage as she acclimates herself to vastly changed circumstances.

episodes.title: Testimony
episodes.summary: June confronts a painful reminder of her Gilead past. Lawrence presents something helpful to Aunt Lydia.

episodes.title: Progress
episodes.summary: Serena and Fred greet unexpected visitors from Gilead. Aunt Lydia deals with a hunger strike at the Red Center.

episodes.title: The Wilderness
episodes.summary: June draws on all her resources and relationships, risking everything to ensure her own kind of justice.

episodes.title: Morning
episodes.summary: June confronts the consequences of killing Fred. A scared Serena makes an unexpected decision.

episodes.title: Ballet
episodes.summary: June struggles to move on with her life in Toronto. Serena plans an elaborate memorial. Aunt Lydia and Janine prepare Esther for her first posting as a Handmaid.

episodes.title: Border
episodes.summary: June and Moira join a rebel outpost. As a pregnant widow, Serena tries to restore her status. Aunt Lydia questions her strict methods of dealing with Handmaids.

episodes.title: Dear Offred
episodes.summary: June fights her need for violent revenge as Serena settles into her new role in Toronto. Rattled by Janine, Aunt Lydia makes a surprising suggestion to Lawrence.

episodes.title: Fairytale
episodes.summary: June and Luke embark on a dangerous quest. Serena gets to know her new hosts.

episodes.title: Together
episodes.summary: June and Luke's mission puts them in serious jeopardy. Serena senses a threat from her benefactors. Lawrence and Nick make a shocking power move.

episodes.title: No Man's Land
episodes.summary: June and Serena find themselves in a desperate situation.

episodes.title: Motherland
episodes.summary: June considers a tempting but risky offer from a surprise visitor. Serena hits rock bottom and searches for allies.

episodes.title: Allegiance
episodes.summary: June and Luke prepare for a rescue mission. Serena tries new tactics with her oppressive hosts. Lawrence makes a surprising proposal to elevate his status.

episodes.title: Safe
episodes.summary: Under threat, June must find a way to keep herself and her family safe from Gilead and its violent supporters in Toronto.

episodes.title: Train
episodes.summary: June and Serena's journey takes an unexpected turn. Moira makes a bold decision. Nick deals with a powerful visitor.

episodes.title: Exile
episodes.summary: June tries to settle in a new community. Serena seeks a sanctuary. Luke and Moira take a big risk.

episodes.title: Devotion
episodes.summary: June struggles to save her loved ones. Commander Lawrence welcomes diplomats to New Bethlehem. Aunt Lydia searches for Janine.

episodes.title: Promotion
episodes.summary: June disrupts the rebels' plans. Commander Lawrence gains power and influence.

episodes.title: Janine
episodes.summary: June and Moira go undercover. Serena and Nick make consequential choices.

episodes.title: Surprise
episodes.summary: June hides in an unexpected place.

episodes.title: Shattered
episodes.summary: After a shocking revelation, June spirals. Serena plans for a prestigious future.

episodes.title: Exodus
episodes.summary: June and Moira execute their dangerous plan. Serena makes a big commitment.

episodes.title: Execution
episodes.summary: June faces her biggest challenge as Gilead cracks down on the rebels.

episodes.title: The Handmaid's Tale
episodes.summary: June reflects on her experiences in Gilead and decides what to do next.
